sources.title: kusuriya-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-EXL3-INT8-4bpw · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EXL3-INT8 quantization of the DFlash 2 draft model z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 (published by inco.ai as incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2; see SOURCE_MODEL_CARD.md). Like the original, it is not a standalone language model: it drafts tokens for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B inside a speculative decoding runtime, and the target model verifies them, so the output is the target's own greedy output.
